name: rpg-mcp
description: A persistent, rules-aware RPG engine (SRD 5.2.1) that turns your AI into a game master for campaigns that last for years.

interface.shortDescription: Your AI as a game master
interface.longDescription: Play long-running tabletop RPG campaigns with your AI as the Game Master. The engine owns the rules and the truth: characters, HP, money, XP, inventory, time, party, relationships, events and checkpoints live in one local SQLite file, so a campaign runs across many conversations without any chat transcript. SRD 5.2.1 rules content is embedded; no account, no network access. Requires Node.js 18 or newer and a supported native platform; setup downloads the pinned executable from GitHub Releases.
capabilities: Track characters, dice, combat and loot
